species: Five hundred thousand OVCAR3 (transduced with wild-type or G12D mutated KRAS, fused with PAmCherry) cells were placed in 100mm × 20mm cell culture plates and treated with or without anti-human KRASG12D-IgA1 or KRASG12D-IgG4 or non-specific human IgA (Abcam, ab91025) at 0.5 μg/ml final concentration or vehicle (PBS) in low serum media.
tissue: Mutation-specific dIgA, but not IgG, neutralized KRASG12D within ovarian carcinoma cells and expelled this oncodriver from tumor cells.
cell_type: Dimeric IgA (dIgA) can move through cells via the IgA/IgM polymeric immunoglobulin receptor (PIGR), which is expressed mainly on mucosal epithelia.
